lane: Mobile auth language + Supabase auth email templates (cross-cutting: auth)
goal: Show the welcome, sign-up and sign-in screens in the phone language on first launch (Vietnamese phones get Vietnamese, every other language gets English), let people switch language on those screens, send the language as user_metadata.locale at sign-up and update it when a signed-in person changes language in Settings, and send auth emails in that language (Vietnamese when locale is missing). Also records Owner-approved 15/11 operations: Site URL, Admin staging switched to Singapore, email templates applied.
successCriteria: detectDeviceLanguage maps vi -> vi, en and any other language -> en, unreadable -> vi; unit tests cover it.
A new install with no saved profile starts in the device language; a saved profile keeps its language.
The language menu is visible on the welcome, sign-up and sign-in views.
signUp sends options.data.locale equal to the language shown when the button is pressed; tests cover it.
Changing language in Settings while signed in calls auth.updateUser with data.locale.
Templates confirmation, recovery, invite and password_changed_notification have one English branch on user_metadata.locale and a Vietnamese default; validate-auth-email-templates passes.
PLAN.md and the rollout receipt record the Site URL, Admin staging switch and template application.
untouchedSurfaces: Admin code, Edge Functions and migrations are unchanged; admin-team-invite sends no locale so invites stay Vietnamese.
Other email templates (magic link, email change, MFA and so on) are unchanged and not enabled.
Content data and seed files are unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Welcome, sign-up and sign-in screens show a language menu; first launch picks the phone language.
impact.dataWrite: No new storage key; language stays in nilaza.profile. Supabase user_metadata gains locale (vi or en).
impact.backendContract: signUp options.data adds locale; auth.updateUser data.locale on Settings change; email templates read .Data.locale only in one comparison.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin change; Admin staging now reads the Singapore project (Vercel env), recorded in the receipt.
impact.privacySafety: Only the two-letter app language is sent; no region, time zone or device data. Templates never print user metadata.
impact.observability: No new events; failures to update locale are silent and leave the previous language in place.
impact.rollback: Revert the app commit; templates fall back to Vietnamese when locale is missing; dashboard templates can be restored from git history.

canonicalContracts: apps/mobile/src/i18n.ts owns language options and device mapping
supabase/templates/auth/manifest.json owns live subjects and the locale expression

sourceReview.reason: Owner approval boundary for settings, SQL and deploys.
Invites send no locale, so the invite template falls back to Vietnamese.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Record before app edits; template edits made earlier this session are listed in workingTreeReview; Owner approved applying templates, Site URL and the Admin switch on 15/11.

dependencyReview.evidence: Adds expo-localization via npx expo install (version chosen by Expo for SDK 54). getLocales() is synchronous and returns languageCode; confirmed from the installed package type definitions. Supabase email templates expose .Data (user_metadata) to subject and body, confirmed in the dashboard template variable list and the Supabase docs on 2026-11-15. npx expo install also added the default "expo-localization" config plugin entry (no options) to app.json; i18n loads the module lazily so text-only modules and their tests do not load the native module.

externalSourceReview.reason: getLocales() returns the ordered device locales with languageCode.
Data contains auth.users.user_metadata and can personalize templates.

securityReview.authzRls: No RLS or role change; updateUser only edits the signed-in user's own metadata.
securityReview.sensitiveData: No journal, birth or chat data; only the app language code.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Only the publishable Singapore key was placed in Vercel env; no secret values read or logged.
securityReview.externalInput: user_metadata.locale is user controlled, so templates only compare it and never print it.
securityReview.dependencies: One Expo first-party package, expo-localization, installed with npx expo install.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No migration; a new Android build is needed before users see the app change.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if templates would print user metadata or if expo-localization needs config plugin options beyond the default entry npx expo install adds to app.json.

workingTreeReview.note: Email templates, manifest and validator were edited and applied to Supabase before this record, on Owner instruction to apply the approved content; recorded here per protocol.

managerTestPath: Install the next Android test build on a phone set to English: welcome screen is English; switch to Tiếng Việt on Sign up, register, and the confirmation email is Vietnamese.
residualRisk: Device behaviour and real inbox delivery are not verified until the next Android build and a real sign-up.
